name: Family Cloud Design 1.0 (Journey Design 2.1)
description: Single source for the app's design tokens, copied from Journey's Design 2.1 so both apps look like one family. The hub (design/hub) is generated from it, and the app's theme file will be too. Keep it in step with Journey's design/tokens.json: a change to colour, type or shape belongs in both.

font.stack: "Plus Jakarta Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

accent.note: Sun, the same accent as Journey. The owner chose it for Journey on 8 Nov 2026 and asked for the same here.

sun.label: Sun
sun.note: Golden yellow. Energetic and optimistic, made for challenges.

brand.note: The app has no final name yet. The hub shows each candidate on every screen; set "chosen" when the owner picks one, and the screens, share links and logo follow.

porchlight.label: Porchlight
porchlight.line: The light left on for you. Journey is where you go; this is what you come home to.

homeport.label: Homeport
homeport.line: The harbour a boat belongs to. Every journey leaves from it and comes back.

kith.label: Kith
kith.line: From "kith and kin": friends and family, in one old word.

fold.label: Fold
fold.line: Your fold is your people. It also folds papers away.

familycloud.label: Family Cloud
familycloud.line: The working title. Says what it is, but leaves friends out and is hard to own.

places.note: The seven places in Home's top row. Only the one that used to be called Notes has a name still open to change: set its label here and every screen follows at the next build.

tintNote: Five tints tell people and categories apart where a name or a face won't fit: a dot in the month grid, a bar in a chart. Always next to a label somewhere on the screen, never the only signal, and never for buttons.

fixed.note: The same in light and dark. Stage is the near-black behind full-photo screens; scrim dims the page under a sheet; black is behind photos opened edge to edge; white is the knob of a switch.
The same in light and dark: under a sheet, under a switch's knob, around a picture that overlaps a photo, and under a card on the stage.

layout.note: Where a screen's content starts from the edge, and the room above a section. Gaps inside a component are plain numbers on a 2-point grid.

typeNote: Every text size in the app is one of these. In the app each is a Txt variant, named in camelCase ("Body small" is bodySmall). Tracking is in em.
